pr_title: Bluetooth: shell: Fix uninitalized values for iso big create
pr_body:
A few values were not initialized when creating a
big in the iso shell.

Signed-off-by: Emil Gydesen <emil.gydesen@nordicsemi.no>

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/39857

review_comments:
In order to avoid the same problem when you add something else, maybe memset or initialize the entire struct to zero?
Would _INIT macros be helpful?

I did consider the memset approach. I can add that if you like

Didn't consider the _INIT macro approach, but definitely something that could also make sense. 

Please let me know if you want either approach, or if this is good enough as is.
This was just a suggestion. I'm fine with leaving it as is.
I'll try to keep that in mind, and possibly add that later :)
